      @Test public void testObjectIdSerializingViaTokenBuffer() throws org.testcontainers.shaded.com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonProcessingException
      mapper.convertValue serializes into a TokenBuffer and then deserializes again. This excercises a code path in the EmbeddedObjectSerializer which serializes ObjectIds as an embedded object.
